# Bounded HEVC copied-control and actual-command recorder

**AI disclosure:** This file, including its title and all prose, was generated by AI.

Experimental default-off recorder for [omarchy-m1-video#70](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/70).
It copies numeric SPS/PPS/scaling/one-slice/decode-flag values at the applied
job and records selected non-address header/scaling/QP/deblock/weight/location
words plus coded size/relative offset for pictures 24–34. Writer history covers
all 300 pictures. Parent
[libva-v4l2_request#42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42)
and follow-up campaign [#71](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/71)
stay open.

This issue **does not authorize module load**. Completing this leaf does not
complete the measured campaign or correct RPS_E.

## Reproduce without hardware

```
python3 experiments/hevc-full-controls/verify-sources.py
python3 experiments/hevc-full-controls/report.py --verify
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-command-trace/tests.py
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-trace/fetch.py /tmp/avd-pristine
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-command-trace/prepare.py \
  --source /tmp/avd-pristine --destination /tmp/avd-cmdtrace
python3 experiments/hevc-avd-command-trace/source-tests.py /tmp/avd-pristine
```

`prepare.py` applies the 15 shipped patches and the **accepted**
`hevc-avd-trace/hooks.patch` read-only, then additive command-trace sources.
It does not install or execute a module. Omit `--headers` unless recording a
matching ARM64 module build as a campaign gate.

Debugfs (after a later authorized load, not this PR):
`/sys/kernel/debug/apple_avd_hevc_cmdtrace/{control,status,snapshot}` with the
same `arm RUN TGID` / `seal RUN` / `off` verbs as the accepted recorder.
Allocation: `sizeof(cmd_capture) + 1,261,568` (schema-2 history) is asserted
`<= 2 MiB`.

## What is and is not recorded

Selected: header scalars, scaling words, QP, deblock, weights, CABAC/CTB/MV
location, coded size/relative offset/NEW_SLICE flags.
Never: unclassified command ranges, coded high/low address words, DMA bases,
DPB timestamps, padding.

Inactive scaling/weights produce an explicit skipped record, not a zero word.
Missing inputs cannot become defaults (`parser.MissingInput`).
